evidence: The wiki gives Staggering Blow as 14 to 116 bonus physical damage on top of a basic attack, so the tooltip's '(+100% AD)' is the attack's own damage and the total is correct (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Nautilus/Staggering_Blow).

The wiki says Nether Grasp tethers the target, knocking them down, and then suppresses them during the channel, so 'Knocks Down' is accurate (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Malzahar/Nether_Grasp).

The wiki gives Tentacle slam damage as 9 to 180 (+110% AD +40% AP), raised by 10% at Tentacle Smash rank 1, which matches the tooltip's 9.9 to 198 (+121% AD +44% AP) (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Illaoi/Prophet_of_an_Elder_God).

The wiki's slam base is 9 to 180 (+110% AD +40% AP) with a 10% to 30% increase from Tentacle Smash rank, so the tooltip's 9.9 to 198 at rank 1 is correct and 9 to 162 is not what the game uses (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Illaoi/Prophet_of_an_Elder_God).

The wiki says Hammer Stance grants 5 to 26 (+7.5% bonus AD) bonus armor and magic resist, the same value for both, which is what the tooltip's 'X Armor and Magic Resist' says (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Jayce/Transform_Mercury_Hammer).

The wiki gives Edge of Ixtal a 525 range and the enchanted Elemental Wrath about 865 maximum range, so 'gains extra range' is true (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Qiyana/Elemental_Wrath).

The wiki confirms healing is 25% effective against minions and monsters, but the game's full tooltip already says so in its below-line rule (spell_ambessar_tooltipextendedbelowline), so the tooltip is not wrong (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Ambessa/Public_Execution).

The wiki says the next 3 basic attacks or abilities against the marked target deal bonus magic damage, which matches the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Evelynn/Hate_Spike).

The wiki says Power Fist's attack deals 100% AD (+25% AP) bonus physical damage, so the attack totals 200% AD +25% AP as the tooltip shows (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Blitzcrank/Power_Fist).
The wiki says the shield increase is capped at 60% missing health, which matches the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Shen/Stand_United).
The wiki says Zyra's plants deal 50 to 100 (by level) bonus damage to non-epic monsters, which matches the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zyra).
The wiki gives Storm Stance's empowered attacks 10 to 40 (by level) (+35% AP) magic damage, which matches the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Udyr/Wingborne_Storm).

The wiki lists a 10-second on-target cooldown for Call of the Freljord, which matches the tooltip's 'once every 10 seconds per target' (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Nunu/Call_of_the_Freljord).

The wiki says Savagery adds 20 to 160 (+5% AD) to the basic attack, so the attack totals 20/55/90/125/160 (+105% AD) as the tooltip shows (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Rengar/Savagery).
The wiki says Harrier deals 75 bonus physical damage against monsters, which matches the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Quinn/Harrier).
The wiki's Pets section lists bloblet health as 12% of Zac's maximum health (plus 1), which matches the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zac).

The wiki gives Sundering Slam 4% to 6% (+4% per 100 bonus AD) max health damage, which is what the tooltip shows, so the wrong row key in the level-up list has no visible effect (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Ambessa/Sundering_Slam).

The wiki says Deathbringer Stance's damage is capped at 100 to 320 (by level) against monsters, which matches the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Aatrox/Deathbringer_Stance).

The wiki says the empowered shockwave stuns for 0.8 seconds, but the in-game tooltip reads @StunDuration@ from KSanteQ (1.0) instead of KSanteQ3 (0.8), so it says 1 second (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_K'Sante/Ntofo_Strikes).

The wiki says the Sun Disc loses 100 armor and 100 magic resistance while Azir is dead or too far away, which matches the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Template:Data_Azir/Shurima's_Legacy).
